name: The Dragon Prince
description: An extraordinary discovery inspires two human princes and an elven assassin to team up on an epic quest to bring peace to their warring lands.

videos.title: Echoes of Thunder
videos.overview: As the human kingdom of Katolis braces for an attack by Moonshadow elves, King Harrow makes plans to send sons Callum and Ezran away to a safe place.

videos.title: What Is Done
videos.overview: Determined to make up for her mistake, Rayla sneaks into the castle and corners Callum. Lord Viren offers the king a way to survive the attack.

videos.title: Moonrise
videos.overview: With night falling, Rayla and the princes race to share what they've found and stop the attack. But first they'll have to get past Claudia.

videos.title: Bloodthirsty
videos.overview: Excited about his newfound powers, Callum convinces the others to travel to the Banther Lodge for a magic cube. Katolis prepares to crown a new king.

videos.title: An Empty Throne
videos.overview: Callum struggles to control his magic, General Amaya clashes with Lord Viren, and a trip down the river takes a hair-raising turn.

videos.title: Through the Ice
videos.overview: After a run-in with a soldier, Rayla leads the princes to high ground. Viren gives Soren and Claudia secret orders as they set out on their mission.

videos.title: The Dagger and the Wolf
videos.overview: In a nearby village, Callum and Ezran seek help for the egg while Rayla hunts down a magic blade. Claudia collects ingredients for a tracking spell.

videos.title: Cursed Caldera
videos.overview: Ellis leads the friends to the Cursed Caldera but warns it's crawling with nasty monsters. Viren tries to force Runaan to talk.

videos.title: Wonderstorm
videos.overview: Ezran, Callum and Rayla each put their special talents to use as they make their way up the mountain in a desperate bid to save the egg.

videos.title: A Secret and a Spark
videos.overview: Before marching on toward Xadia, Callum begs Lujanne for a magic lesson, and Ezran tries to teach the dragon prince to fly. But danger is closing in.

videos.title: Half Moon Lies
videos.overview: After a fierce showdown with Rayla, Soren and Claudia argue about the best way to deal with the princes. Rayla worries she's kept a secret too long.

videos.title: Smoke and Mirrors
videos.overview: Callum searches for a way to tell Ezran the sad news, and Rayla sets a trap for Claudia and Soren. Viren watches a mysterious figure in the mirror.

videos.title: Voyage of the Ruthless
videos.overview: After saying goodbye to Phoe-Phoe, the gang teams up with a pirate to cross a bay, where Callum tries to forge a connection with the sky arcanum.

videos.title: Breaking the Seal
videos.overview: At the summit of the five kingdoms, Viren fights to win the support of a young queen. Flashbacks reveal a key moment from King Harrow's reign.

videos.title: Heart of a Titan
videos.overview: The attack on the Magma Titan has devastating consequences for two kingdoms. In his letter, Harrow shares a lie, a secret and a wish for the princes.

videos.title: Fire and Fury
videos.overview: When Soren picks a fight with a dragon, chaos breaks out -- and Rayla faces a difficult decision. A defeated Viren returns to the figure in the mirror.

videos.title: The Book of Destiny
videos.overview: Callum pays a price for dabbling in dark magic. Claudia searches desperately for a way to help Soren, and Ezran makes a heartbreaking discovery.

videos.title: Breathe
videos.overview: After using his gift to help Claudia, Ezran makes an important decision about the quest. Callum wakes up with a new understanding of primal magic.

videos.title: Sol Regem
videos.overview: To cross into Xadia, Rayla and Callum must find a way past a fearsome dragon who was blinded in a battle with a human.

videos.title: The Crown
videos.overview: At his first High Council meeting, King Ezran faces a flurry of difficult decisions. Rayla guides Callum through a wonderland of magical creatures.

videos.title: Ghost
videos.overview: Rayla returns home to an alarming discovery, the Sunfire elves decide Amaya's fate, and Claudia confronts her father.

videos.title: The Midnight Desert
videos.overview: A mysterious stranger offers Rayla, Callum and Zym a ride across the Midnight Desert. With Katolis in danger, Ezran makes a startling announcement.

videos.title: Heroes and Masterminds
videos.overview: Rayla and Callum race across the desert to find Nyx. As Katolis prepares for war, Ezran gets help from an unlikely source.

videos.title: Thunderfall
videos.overview: On the march to Xadia, Viren reveals how Avizandum, the Dragon King, met his end. Phoe-Phoe takes Ezran on an epic journey.

videos.title: Hearts of Cinder
videos.overview: As Team Zym begins the steep climb up to the Dragon Queen's lair, Viren and Aaravos play a nasty trick on the Sunfire elves.

videos.title: Dragonguard
videos.overview: With Viren's glowing army closing in on the Storm Spire, Rayla, Callum and friends must decide whether to flee to safety or stay and fight.

videos.title: The Final Battle
videos.overview: Determined to save the Dragon Prince at any cost, the friends brace for a fiery showdown with Viren -- who still has a few surprises up his sleeve.

videos.title: Rebirthday
videos.overview: Two years later, Claudia finally completes her resurrection spell, Ezran plans a surprise for Katolis, and Janai takes Amaya on a secret mission.

videos.title: Fallen Stars
videos.overview: Facing another journey up the steep Storm Spire, Viren panics. Janai's brother pushes back against her plans. Callum attempts to decode the mirror.

videos.title: Breathtaking
videos.overview: An unexpected visitor leaves Callum reeling. Soren puts on a show to welcome the dragons — while in Xadia, his sister searches their lair.

videos.title: Through the Looking Glass
videos.overview: The story of Aaravos's dark past comes to light. Claudia prepares to open the chrysalis. The tension between humans and Sunfire elves boils over.

videos.title: The Great Gates
videos.overview: While Ezran and team set out on a quest to visit the Archdragon of Earth, Claudia and Viren try to communicate with the mysterious being.

videos.title: The Drakewood
videos.overview: Zym helps the friends search the forest for a missing Soren. In the Sunfire elves' camp, Queen Janai calls a tribunal to decide the architect's fate.

videos.title: Beneath the Surface
videos.overview: As N'than guides the heroes through the treacherous Path of Despair, Soren tries to convince Claudia to change her ways.

videos.title: Rex Igneous
videos.overview: At last, the friends come face to face with the mighty dragon — only to discover he's expecting gifts. Karim hatches a plot to dethrone the queen.

videos.title: Escape from Umber Tor
videos.overview: Dark spells, dirty tricks and a very unusual map ignite a fiery confrontation in Rex Igneous's lair. Janai squares off against her brother.

videos.title: Domina Profundis
videos.overview: While Ezran awaits an audience with the Archdragon of the Ocean, Rayla hunts for answers about her parents, and Callum hits a roadblock in his research.

videos.title: Old Wounds
videos.overview: Worried by Claudia's relentless pace, Terry dreams up a creative solution. Rayla and Callum set out for Lux Aurea. Ezran prepares to address the dragons.

videos.title: Nightmares and Revelations
videos.overview: Callum and Rayla arrive in Xadia to find royal wedding planning in full swing. Claudia and Terry make their way down the river while Viren sleeps on.

videos.title: The Great Bookery
videos.overview: As Callum scours Lux Aurea's library for lore of the Startouch elves, Amaya clears the air with Rayla. Karim meets a powerful potential ally.

videos.title: Archmage Akiyu
videos.overview: Ezran convinces the group to look for an eccentric ocean mage with critical information. Karim calls in a debt. Claudia tries to communicate with Viren.

videos.title: Bait and Switch
videos.overview: In search of seaworthy transportation, Rayla leads the way to an unsavory port town run by a cunning elf. Claudia takes a stand.

videos.title: Sea Legs
videos.overview: The Ruthless sails into dangerous waters, with Finnegrin in hot pursuit. Queen Janai and her guards face a deadly infiltrator seeking the Sun Seed.

videos.title: Finnegrin's Wake
videos.overview: Held captive aboard the Sea Legs, Callum and his crew must dig deep to win their freedom. Janai faces her brother once again.

videos.title: Infantis Sanguine
videos.overview: While Zubeia fights for her life and Viren arrives at a crossroads, the race toward Aaravos' prison leads those who seek him deep beneath the waves.

videos.title: Startouched
videos.overview: A shocking reversal leaves Claudia grief-stricken. Home in Katolis, Callum, Rayla and Ezran debate what to do with the Pearl that imprisons Aaravos.

videos.title: Love, War and Mushrooms
videos.overview: Soren travels to Xadia, where he and Corvus follow a mysterious trail into the woods. Janai faces her frustrations — and her future.

videos.title: The Frozen Ship
videos.overview: On their journey to the Starscraper, Rayla and Callum spend a chilly night at an unusual campsite. Terry offers Claudia some comfort.

videos.title: The Starscraper
videos.overview: The Celestial Elves greet Callum and Rayla with a puzzling prophecy. Karim presents a gift to Sol Regem. Soren returns home to a surprise.

videos.title: Moonless Night
videos.overview: To prove themselves as the Chosen Two, Rayla and Callum set out to end the storms swirling around the Starscraper. Viren tries to right past wrongs.

videos.title: Moment of Truth
videos.overview: Memories of Soren's childhood weigh heavily on Viren. Kosmo uses his new powers to help Callum see his true self clearly.

videos.title: The Red Wedding
videos.overview: Sol Regem emerges from his long exile — on Janai and Amaya's wedding day. Hoping to make peace with Karim, Ezran rides into danger.

videos.title: We All Fall Down
videos.overview: Callum and Rayla head to the Moon Nexus. When Katolis faces a devastating attack, Soren turns to an unlikely source for help.

videos.title: Stardust
videos.overview: A visit to the spirit realm forces Rayla to make a heartbreaking choice. Aaravos shares a story from his past with Claudia.

videos.title: Death Alive
videos.overview: Atop the Starscraper, Kosmo receives an ominous prophecy about the fate of Xadia. As Callum returns to a devastated Katolis, Aaravos hatches a new plot.

videos.title: True Heart
videos.overview: Tensions rise as Ezran grapples with rebuilding Katolis and deciding Runaan's punishment. Meanwhile, Claudia, Aaravos and Terry search for a hidden map.

videos.title: The Glittering Bones
videos.overview: Terry leads the group to the Garden of Innocents, where Aaravos and Claudia craft a primal stone. In Lux Aurea, Janai faces a tough decision about Karim.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: After an emotional reunion, Rayla undergoes a ritual to reverse her banishment. Terry has a heartbreaking realization about Claudia.

videos.title: Sticky Fingers
videos.overview: Desperate to stop Claudia, Terry exposes Aaravos' terrible plans. Amaya appeals to Karim one last time, while Callum and Rayla share a peaceful moment.

videos.title: Inversion
videos.overview: In a last-ditch effort to change Claudia's mind, Soren surprises her with someone familial. Back at the Silvergrove, Callum battles his inner darkness.

videos.title: The Titan and the King
videos.overview: While Callum and his friends race to stop Aaravos from bringing about Eternal Night, the trapped Startouch elf gives Ezran a grim history lesson.

videos.title: Dying Light
videos.overview: A shocking betrayal turns the tide in Aaravos' favor. With Eternal Night upon them, Callum and his allies rally in a desperate final stand.

videos.title: Nova
videos.overview: As the final battle reaches its climax, Callum chooses to embrace his destiny. Claudia's interference forces Rayla to make a heart-wrenching decision.
